notes: Measurement-driven session with numeric evidence attached to decisions.

messages.content: The dashboard takes 4.2s to first paint. Needs to be under 1.5s.
Profiled it. The bundle is 2.1MB. Decided: code splitting with React.lazy for the chart routes. Updated src/App.tsx and src/routes.tsx.
Completed: route-level code splitting, bundle is now 780KB and first paint is 1.9s. The remaining cost is the moment.js locale bundle.
Decided: date-fns instead of moment.js — tree-shakeable, saves about 230KB. Updated src/utils/format.ts and package.json.
First paint is 1.3s now, under the target. Working on preloading the fonts in index.html.
